heading: TRIO TWIST  BEEF
description: The trio twist beef is a real treat for your four-legged friend. It is a braid of clear rawhide with a tasty strip of beef and rawhide.
bodyDescription: The VOSKES Trio Twist Beef is a plait made from white cowhide, a tasty strip of beef and rawhide. A chewy and delicious snack. Its shape also helps to keep teeth clean.
